pr_title: fs: make params in writing methods optional
pr_body:
Closes: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/41666

Depends on: https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42768 (reading counterparts, <https://github.com/nodejs/node/labels/semver-minor>)

Formerly a part of https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/41677

An attempt to implement "named parameters" for [fs.write()](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#fswritefd-buffer-offset-length-position-callback) (Callback API), [filehandle.write()](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#filehandlewritebuffer-offset-length-position) (Promises API) and [fs.writeSync()](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#fswritesyncfd-buffer-offset-length-position) (Synchronous API).

Mandatory `buffer` argument is followed by optional `options` object with optional `offset`, `length`, `position` properties.
pr_comments: I wonder if it would make sense to wait for DEP0162 to be EOL (so Node.js v19.x or later) so all FS write functions can use the same "signature".

> I wonder if it would make sense to wait for DEP0162 to be EOL (so Node.js v19.x or later) so all FS write functions can use the same "signature".

I'm fine with any verdict on this, but I don't see significant reasons for waiting.
If by "same signature" you mean simply aligning [fs.write](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#fswritefd-buffer-offset-length-position-callback) (Callback API), the signatures are different anyways, because [fs.readSync](https://nodejs.org/api/fs.html#fsreadsyncfd-buffer-options) doesn't include `buffer` in `options` object. So there's no strong consistency&interoperability to keep.

Adding `fs.write(fd[, options], callback)`, `fs.readSync(fd[, options])` and `fs.writeSync(fd[, options])` after DEP0162 looks doable, and not blocking for this PR.
That makes sense to me. FWIW you could use footnotes to make your comment easier to follow: https://github.blog/changelog/2021-09-30-footnotes-now-supported-in-markdown-fields/

Thanks! These are really helpful.

Temporarily converting this PR to draft for rewriting `fh.write()` part and adding `fs.write(fd, buffer, options, callback)` version.
~Blocked on https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42837.~ EDIT: no, I got confused, the other PR is for reading method, this one is for writing methods, no reason to block
@LiviaMedeiros Can you please rebase to fix the git conflict?

With https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42601/commits/f2ed73158be8db5fcf2867c39e3dfbc68ffa04b6, https://github.com/nodejs/node/pull/42768 becomes a hard dependency for this PR.

Not sure if `EBADF` in `test/parallel/test-fs-read-position-validation.mjs` are caused by a bug, or just flaky due to many async I/O activities. :confused:

If I understood the root of failure correctly, both `test/parallel/test-fs-write-sync-optional-params.js` and `test/parallel/test-fs-read-position-validation.mjs` are failing randomly due to some sort of flakiness caused by simultaneous I/O operations via Callback API. Making them sequential via `util.promisify` should help.
